name: Finding Love
overview: Scripture reveals that finding love is rooted in God's design for marriage, where a man leaves his parents and unites with his wife to become one flesh, reflecting a sacred and intimate bond (Genesis 2:24; Matthew 19:5). True delight in the Lord aligns our desires with His will, enabling us to receive the deepest longings of our hearts (Psalms 37:4). The Bible honors the blessing of a virtuous wife, describing her value as far above rubies and encouraging rejoicing in the wife of one's youth, emphasizing faithfulness and godly character (Proverbs 31:10; Proverbs 5:18). Finding a wife is portrayed as obtaining favor from the Lord, underscoring that love and marriage are gifts from God to be treasured and respected (Proverbs 18:22).
